facts.fact: 叙述者说法语把CIA称作“la CIA”，以此证明她是女性
facts.anchor: Why else would the French call her “la CIA”?

facts.fact: 叙述者称CIA是世界上最古老的第二职业，仅次于最古老的职业
facts.anchor: It is the world’s second oldest profession, after all, which is pretty close to the oldest, you must admit.

facts.fact: 叙述者说CIA至少在某些部位是年轻柔软的二十多岁
facts.anchor: But clearly she’s a young, supple twenty-something, at least in parts.

facts.fact: 叙述者把Frank Olson列入被CIA引诱致死的天真者名单
叙述者把约翰·菲茨杰拉德·肯尼迪总统列入同一名单
叙述者把CIA比作69岁的荷兰妓女
叙述者说CIA已经69岁且被充分使用
facts.anchor: She’s 69 years old. And she’s well-used.
